Major Location: the broad body or signing-space region where the sign is produced
Minor Location: the more specific location within the broad signing region
Second Minor Location: an additional specific location used by the sign
Contact: whether the articulators visibly make contact
Handshape: the canonical configuration of the dominant hand
Selected Fingers: which fingers are selected or active in the hand configuration
Flexion: the degree or type of finger bending
Flexion Change: whether finger flexion changes during the sign
Spread: whether the selected fingers are spread
Spread Change: whether finger spread changes during the sign
Thumb Position: the position of the thumb relative to the fingers or palm
Thumb Contact: whether the thumb contacts another part of the hand
Sign Type: the one-handed or two-handed structural type of the sign
Path Movement: the geometric path followed by the moving articulator
Nondominant Handshape: the handshape of the nondominant hand
Wrist Twist: whether the wrist twists during the sign
